summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (filer) disclosed entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Anysphere, Inc. (Cursor) via its wholly owned subsidiary X67 Inc. Each share of Cursor common and preferred stock will be converted into shares of the company's Class A common stock based on an implied equity value of $60.0 billion, with the stock price determined by the volume-weighted average closing price over the seven trading days before closing. The merger is expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. The consideration is stock-only, and shares will be issued in reliance on Section 4(a)(2) exemption. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any shareholder approvals.
